graph_props.Description:
This PCG graph will create all the roads. Reading the road categories created in the Scene Graph from the district subdivisions. It will solve intersection and assign shape grammar definition to have the road created, spawned and projected on the terrain. The road footprint will be later used to create the lots where the building will be. Road widths for each category are adjustable. 
IMPORTANT : The roads will Partially level the terrain to ensure smooth slopes. Generating the road PCG graph will modify the terrain and will re-trigger anything that is using the terrain as a base.
